critical_code_review_comments: auth_router.py _clear_refresh_cookie() calls response.delete_cookie() but does NOT pass httponly=True. Starlette/FastAPI's delete_cookie preserves the other flags via Max-Age=0 which is fine functionally, but for defence-in-depth on strict UAs it's cleaner to Set-Cookie with the SAME attributes (httponly, secure, samesite, path) on deletion. Currently the test passes because the browser matches on name+path+domain and drops the cookie, but the header emitted lacks HttpOnly on the deletion line. Non-blocking.

google_callback route: on Emergent OAuth exchange failure the raised HTTPException 401 embeds the raw exception message ('OAuth verification failed: {e}'). This can leak upstream service details (URL, HTTP status, sometimes headers). Recommend replacing with a static string 'OAuth verification failed' and logging the details server-side only.

assessment_router._shuffle_options builds `remap` as {orig_index: new_index} via `for new, orig in enumerate(idx)`. The variable naming is confusing — idx[new] == orig, i.e. idx is a permutation that maps new→orig positions. The comment '# so submit can decode against course truth' is helpful but the perm returned as `_option_permutation` (== idx) is stored under the client-facing key 'permutation'. This is the perm[new_idx]=orig_idx form; the submit path in _grade_answers uses `submitted_indices = [perm[i] for i in submitted_indices]` which correctly translates new→orig. Behaviour is correct and verified by TestQuizSubmitRefactor::test_perm_shuffled_indices_decode_correctly. Suggest adding a docstring on _shuffle_options that the returned permutation is new→orig, since the naming convention is easy to mis-read.

auth_router.refresh uses `Cookie(default=None)` param name `ithr_refresh` — FastAPI matches the cookie name to the parameter name. This is fine, but if COOKIE_SECURE=true is set and the client is on plain http (localhost non-https during dev), the browser will refuse to send the cookie and refresh will always 401. Consider documenting a dev-mode override or auto-detecting request.url.scheme. Non-blocking for prod which is https.
conftest.py hardcodes a fallback bcrypt-happy password that's ephemeral per run — good practice. Confirmed all test-suite files use TEST_USER_PASSWORD from conftest.

Iteration-14 refactor: submit_quiz() split into _grade_answers + _issue_certificate_if_new — clean separation, each helper ≤ 30 lines. team_dashboard split into 4 helpers (_aggregate_per_user_stats, _build_department_breakdown, _top_courses_by_enrollment, _readiness_summary) — each has single responsibility. mentor_chat split into _build_chat/_build_context_block/_preamble_with_history/_persist_mentor_turn — good. _build_passport split into 5 helpers (_ensure_passport_slug, _skills_from_certs, _credential_level_from_certs, _industry_footprint, _learning_hours, _serialise_cert) — good. Complexity drop verified via manual read-through; no function >40 LOC in the refactored surfaces.
